violation_type.title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Adhesive Bandages (26 TAC §746.4003(a)(4))
violation_type.short_title: First Aid Kit Incomplete - Adhesive Bandages
violation_type.typical_finding: The thermometer from the first aid kit in the transportation vehicle was missing.      Note: The thermometer was placed in the first aid kit during the inspection.
